thread:
devon (Customer): Hey team, started seeing a big spike in 429s and tail latency on our Dedicated pool (ded-west-2-prod) around 09:28 UTC. Calls with long contexts (~120k tokens) are getting throttled and a bunch of requests failed with 429s + 502s. request-id: r-9a3f, tenant: acme-neo. Can share logs if helpful.

maria (Support): sorry to hear that — can you paste one or two full request-ids and an example prompt size? also which model variant are you on (gptx-8k / gptx-32k / custom-quant)?

devon (Customer): example ids: r-9a3f, r-9a47. prompt token lengths: ~120k input + 4k output target. Model: gptx-32k-quant (pinned). Happened after a traffic bump from a scheduled campaign.

jon (SRE): thanks — preliminary check of ded-west-2-prod shows a sharp rise in kvcache_evictions/sec at 09:27 and corresponding drop in kvcache_hit_rate. Also saw OOM-like slab compaction events on a few workers. attaching metrics snippet.

jon (SRE): ```
# Metrics sample (minute buckets)
09:24 kvcache_hit_rate=0.91 evict/sec=12 mem_used_gb=152
09:25 kvcache_hit_rate=0.88 evict/sec=48 mem_used_gb=160
09:26 kvcache_hit_rate=0.63 evict/sec=420 mem_used_gb=175
09:27 kvcache_hit_rate=0.41 evict/sec=1200 mem_used_gb=189
09:28 kvcache_hit_rate=0.20 evict/sec=2300 mem_used_gb=192
# logs: worker-7
[09:27:12] slab_compactor: triggered compaction, freed=96MB, fragments=0.47
[09:27:13] kvcache: evict key=conv-xxxxx size=3.2MB reason=pressure
[09:27:14] kvcache: evict key=conv-yyyyy size=2.8MB reason=pressure
[09:27:30] autoscaler: scale_decision=NO_SCALE reason="mem_pressure>threshold & cooldown"
```

lee (Infra): autoscaler saw sustained mem pressure and hit the cooldown because previous scale action was <4m ago. The policy is conservative to avoid flapping with long-context workloads. Looks like fragmentation & large per-request KV windows caused the allocator to degrade effective free memory. That prevented new instances from joining fast enough => global token throttles.

maria (Support): understood. devon — two quick mitigations you can try now to reduce tail 429s while we remediate: 1) reduce max_context for this customer to 48k for the next 30m, 2) enable per-tenant kv_soft_limit to 1.6GB to avoid single-tenant blowup, 3) route a fraction of traffic to gptx-8k fallback.

devon (Customer): how do we set kv_soft_limit?

lee (Infra): you can do it via admin API (we applied a dry-run change on a test tenant earlier):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin-api.reedw.infra/v1/tenants/acme-neo/config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"kv_soft_limit_mb":1600, "max_context_tokens":48000, "fallback_routes": [{"pct":20, "model":"gptx-8k-quant"}] }'
```

maria (Support): also asking SRE to collect a heap/profile from worker-7 and a pprof of the allocator. jon, can you capture pmap + jemalloc stats & attach to thread?

jon (SRE): grabbing them now. posted a short dump: ```
worker-7/jemalloc.stats snippet:
allocated: 203842MB
active: 189432MB
mapped: 210000MB
fragmentation_ratio: 0.56
largest_free_run: 4MB
```

jon (SRE): also noticed kv window sizes for these requests were huge (each conversation kept 30-60MB of KV state). Combined with many long-context clients this caused massive churn. Suggest we tweak kv_eviction_grace=3s and increase prefix sharing for repeated tokens.

devon (Customer): ok applying the admin change now. will report back in 10m.

ops-bot: autoscaler_event: new_instance_requested -> queued (reason: boot_timeout), timestamp=2469800125

maria (Support): when you apply the change, try a small traffic sample first. we'll watch evictions/sec and 429 rate. If autoscaler doesn't catch up within 10-15m we'll escalate to infra to temporarily increase immediate burst capacity on ded-west-2.

devon (Customer): update — applied kv_soft_limit + max_context reduction and routed 25% to gptx-8k. 2m after change evict/sec dropped from ~2300 -> ~320, hit_rate back to ~0.78, and 429s fell about 85%. Latency tails improved. Thanks.

lee (Infra): good. jon will follow up with trimmed heap profiles and a plan: 1) tune allocator thresholds, 2) reduce autoscale cooldown for longctx tenants, 3) add a per-tenant ramp policy for campaign bursts. We'll open an internal RFC for permanent fixes.

maria (Support): closing loop with acme-neo and scheduling a follow-up call to review root cause and permanent mitigations. devon, ping here if you see regressions. :thumbsup:
